review_candidates.title: Founding Engineer
review_candidates.description: This is PlatformPilot At any real scale, it's a struggle to know what your infrastructure actually looks like. It's spread across your codebase, live cloud state, and a dozen dashboards — and none of them agree with each other. PlatformPilot connects the dots on the fly. It's an intelligence system that ties together the intent, the live reality, and the behavior of your infrastructure and the services running on top of it. The result is a living knowledge model that grows as your systems grow and never goes stale. That understanding is what everything else is missing. Engineers rebuild it by hand during an incident; AI tooling assembles it from scratch every time it's asked. We're building the layer that already knows — the accumulated, current, grounded picture that incident tooling, agents, and engineers can all query instead of reconstructing. The reasoning gets commoditised. The context doesn't. Founding Engineer You'd be one of the first engineers here, building alongside the founder. That means shaping the architecture and the product, not implementing someone else's spec. The work spans the whole stack — the core engine, the integrations that feed it, the intelligence built on top, the CLI, and the UI. You won't touch all of it at once, but you'll own whole pieces end to end. It's self-hosted, Go on the backend, and the engine underneath is genuinely hard systems work. What You'll Do • Build the core engine — the reconciliation logic that turns everything we ingest into one continuously updated model. This is the hardest part of the system and everything else sits on top of it. • Connect deeply to cloud providers, IaC tooling, and observability systems — pulling in what each one knows and turning it into one coherent picture. • Build the intelligence on top — what breaks if I ship this, what caused this incident, what's running that nobody needs. The query is easy. Being right is the hard part. • Build the context layer that serves the model outward, so incident tooling, agents, and engineers query real state instead of guessing at it. • Make AI reason over a large, constantly changing model while keeping every answer grounded. We're not building a chatbot. The substance is the engineering underneath. Who You Are: • Strong in Go. If you're excellent in another systems language and want to go deep on Go, we should still talk. • Comfortable across the stack — you can build the backend service and the UI in front of it. • You've built something hard and owned it. Years on a résumé matter far less to us than that. • You take a vague problem, decide the right shape, ship it, and own the outcome. • You use AI as leverage and keep a high bar for what actually ships. Helps if you've worked with cloud infrastructure, IaC, distributed systems, observability, graph data structures, or LLMs — and especially if you've been the person in the war room at 2am. What's Next Send a note to info@platformpilot.co with your résumé or GitHub, plus one thing: The worst deploy you've been on the wrong side of. What broke, what you didn't know at the time, and what would have told you. A few sentences is plenty. We read every application and reply to everyone. → www.platformpilot.co

Role Purpose Lead the independent technical review, validation, and governance of structural assessments, material investigations, analytical models, and intervention strategies for modern heritage buildings across the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. Monitor and supervise structural interventions as required. Key Responsibilities Operations Lead the technical review, validation, and quality assurance of structural assessments, material testing programmes, analytical models, conservation studies, and intervention strategies for modern heritage buildings, sites, districts, and urban heritage landscapes. Assess and interpret the structural behaviour of existing modern heritage buildings, considering material degradation, historical construction practices, incomplete documentation, condition assessments, building pathology investigations, and historic fabric analysis. Review and challenge consultant methodologies, assumptions, site inspection findings, testing results, analytical outputs, and recommendations to ensure conclusions are reliable, proportionate, technically sound, and aligned with conservation principles. Evaluate and validate repair, strengthening, retrofitting, restoration, rehabilitation, adaptive reuse, and other conservation intervention strategies, ensuring minimal intervention, compatibility with existing materials, long-term durability, and preservation of heritage value. Promote evidence-based and performance-based assessment and design approaches, including ASCE 41 where appropriate, particularly where prescriptive code compliance may lead to unnecessary interventions. Ensure proposed interventions balance structural safety requirements with the preservation of authenticity, integrity, architectural character, character-defining features, historic urban character, scale, streetscapes, cultural values, and original material fabric. Review and provide formal technical recommendations on structural submissions, including technical reports, review notes, presentations, specifications, method statements, restoration drawings, intervention guidelines, material treatments, and repair approaches. Support the management of a portfolio of modern heritage assets under assessment by identifying priorities, risks, inconsistencies, feasibility requirements, viability considerations, cost implications, procurement needs, and adaptation or intervention proposals. Supervise and provide technical input on site works related to structural improvements and conservation interventions, including monitoring structural status, site activities, logistics, mobilisation, and compliance with approved methodologies and DCT requirements. Plan, advise, direct, and implement preventive and curative conservation interventions on registered modern architectural heritage, in coordination with relevant DCT functions, external consultants, and contractors. Monitoring, Maintenance and Risk Management Plan, manage, implement, monitor, maintain, and report on modern heritage sites in accordance with approved cyclical maintenance plans. Coordinate condition monitoring, compliance monitoring, risk identification, enforcement recommendations, emergency planning, and corrective actions for deteriorated, abandoned, or at-risk modern heritage assets. Policies, Processes and Procedures Lead and contribute to the development of technical review frameworks, guidelines, procedures, quality standards, templates, and documentation standards for structural assessment and conservation engineering of modern heritage assets. Provide technical expertise in defining acceptable approaches to code application for existing and heritage structures, including performance-based alternatives aligned with DCT objectives and international best practice. Ensure technical reviews, outputs, and activities comply with relevant DCT policies, HED processes and procedures, international standards, and regulatory requirements. Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to strengthen internal processes, review mechanisms, and operational efficiency. Collaboration and Day-to-Day Operations Collaborate with internal teams, external consultants, contractors, municipalities, regulatory authorities, academic institutions, and external partners on technical matters related to structural assessments, conservation interventions, policy implementation, and urban heritage revitalisation. Support technical discussions with stakeholders and provide clear, defensible engineering positions for decision-making and project delivery. Coordinate logistical operations related to permissions and site access for planned studies with site owners and stakeholders. Maintain structured records of technical reviews, decisions, and supporting documentation in line with DCT requirements. Research, Awareness and Capacity Building Lead or contribute to research, innovation, publications, training materials, educational programmes, awareness initiatives, and supporting collateral related to modern heritage conservation, modern building materials, technologies, and capacity building. Build internal and external awareness of appropriate structural engineering and conservation approaches for modern heritage buildings. Respond to ad hoc requests related to modern heritage, conservation advice, reporting, stakeholder support, cross-functional initiatives, and any other duties assigned by the direct manager. Contribute to the dissemination of knowledge within DCT and with relevant external partners, including workshops, technical forums, professional conferences, and academic events, as directed. EHS (Environment, Health and Safety) Comply with all relevant EHS policies, procedures, guidelines, and controls; report incidents and hazards in a timely manner; support employee safety and legislative compliance; and reduce consumption of natural resources to protect the environment and ensure a healthy and safe work environment. Shared Activity Follow all relevant departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Demonstrate compliance with organisational values, ethics, and EHS requirements. Support a culture of change management through a hands-on and can-do approach to DCT’s business opportunities, initiatives, planned targets, and high-performance behaviours. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering. Master’s Degree in Structural Engineering. Professional certifications or memberships, such as PE, are an advantage. 6-8 years of experience in concrete repair and durability engineering, including corrosion mitigation and cathodic protection systems. Experience in structural condition assessment of existing and ageing structures, structural modelling, and advanced analysis. Knowledge of applicable codes and standards, including ADIBC/UAE regulations, ACI 318, ACI 562, ASCE 7, IEBC, and ASCE 41. Proficiency with the following: ETABS, SAFE, SAP2000, AutoCAD, Microsoft Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, etc. Language competency in English is required; Arabic proficiency is preferred. Skills Technical expertise in structural assessment, material testing, analytical modelling, concrete durability, and repair strategy review. Ability to interpret testing results and correlate findings with structural performance. Strong judgment in reviewing consultant submissions and producing clear, defensible technical recommendations. Knowledge of conservation principles, minimal intervention, material compatibility, and long-term durability for modern heritage structures. Proficiency in technical reporting, documentation, stakeholder coordination, and structured record management. Strong communication, collaboration, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and project coordination skills. Interested candidates are welcome to apply or share their CV for consideration.

review_candidates.title: Sales Manager
review_candidates.description: Description The Opportunity: We are seeking an experienced Sales Manager to manage, protect, and grow a broad portfolio of telecommunications operators and regulatory customers across the Middle East and Africa. The role will take commercial ownership of an established portfolio of accounts, with primary responsibility for renewal performance, customer retention, account development, and systematic cross-sell and upsell across Ookla's portfolio. The Sales Manager will establish strong relationships across customer organizations, develop strategic account plans, identify emerging customer priorities and translate them into opportunities for Ookla's connectivity intelligence, analytics, assurance, and professional services solutions. The role will work closely with the VP Sales MEA and regional Sales Directors, providing dedicated day-to-day commercial and relationship coverage. Expectation for Success: Account Management & Customer Growth Own the commercial relationship and development of an assigned portfolio of telecommunications operators and regulatory customers. Develop and execute strategic account plans aligned with the regional growth strategy and each customer's business, network, customer experience, and investment priorities. Build relationships across multiple levels of the customer organization, from operational and technical stakeholders to senior executives and decision-makers. Identify account whitespace and systematically develop cross-sell and upsell opportunities across Ookla's portfolio. Expand relationships beyond existing buying centers into adjacent functions, business units, operating companies, and use cases. Coordinate with Customer Success, technical and Product teams to ensure customers realize measurable value from Ookla solutions. Renewals & Revenue Protection Own commercial renewal planning and execution across the assigned customer portfolio. Establish renewal strategies well ahead of contract expiration, identifying retention risks and required actions early. Monitor customer adoption, stakeholder engagement, satisfaction, competitive activity, and other indicators of account health. Develop mitigation plans for at-risk renewals and escalate material risks appropriately. Protect pricing and commercial value while managing customer procurement and negotiation processes. Maintain accurate visibility of renewal timing, probability, risks, and expected commercial outcomes. Account Expansion & Solution Selling Identify customer challenges and strategic priorities that can be addressed through Ookla's data, analytics, network intelligence, customer experience, service assurance, and professional services capabilities. Lead consultative discovery to translate customer requirements into relevant use cases and commercial opportunities. Build compelling value propositions and business cases linked to measurable customer outcomes. Develop opportunities across network planning and optimization, competitive intelligence, customer experience, service assurance, investment prioritization, regulatory intelligence, and other relevant use cases. Lead opportunities from qualification through solution development, commercial negotiation, contracting, and closure. Pipeline & Forecast Management Build and maintain a healthy expansion pipeline across the assigned portfolio. Maintain accurate opportunity, renewal, and account information within CRM systems. Provide disciplined and evidence-based revenue forecasts, including clear visibility of risks, dependencies, and next steps. Participate in regional sales forecast reviews, account reviews, and business planning processes. Maintain clear distinction between qualified opportunities, potential account whitespace, and committed commercial outcomes. Strategic Account Planning Develop a clear understanding of each customer's strategic priorities, organizational structure, investment programs, competitive environment, and decision-making processes. Map key stakeholders, economic buyers, technical sponsors, influencers, procurement stakeholders, and potential executive sponsors. Identify opportunities to replicate successful use cases across operator groups and their operating companies. Provide customer and market intelligence to support regional commercial and product strategy. Internal Collaboration Work closely with the VP Sales MEA and Sales Directors to align account priorities with the overall regional growth strategy. Coordinate with Customer Success Managers, product teams, and professional services throughout the customer lifecycle. Support Sales Directors on strategic opportunities and executive-level customer engagements where required. Requirements: Education Bachelor's degree in Business, Telecommunications, Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline. MBA or advanced business qualification is advantageous. Experience 7–12 years of business-to-business sales/presales or strategic account management experience, preferably within telecommunications, network intelligence, analytics, software-as-a-service, network assurance, or related technology markets. Proven experience managing and expanding major telecommunications operator accounts. Demonstrated track record of successfully managing complex renewals and protecting recurring revenue. Strong evidence of growing existing customers through cross-sell, upsell, and development of new use cases. Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving technical, commercial, procurement, legal, and executive stakeholders. Strong understanding of telecommunications operators, their organizational structures, network priorities, customer experience challenges, and investment cycles. Experience working across multiple Middle Eastern markets is strongly preferred. Skills & Competencies Strong strategic and key-account management capabilities. Consultative and value-based selling skills. Ability to translate technical capabilities into customer business outcomes. Strong commercial negotiation and contract-management skills. Ability to identify account whitespace and convert customer priorities into qualified opportunities. Strong renewal and revenue-retention discipline. Executive stakeholder management and relationship-building skills. Accurate pipeline management and forecasting discipline. Ability to manage a broad account portfolio while maintaining focus on the highest-value opportunities and risks. Strong collaboration skills across sales, technical, customer success, product, and consulting teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic or other regional languages are advantageous. Success Measures Performance will be measured across: Gross and net revenue retention Renewal performance and reduction of avoidable churn Existing-account revenue growth Cross-sell and upsell bookings Qualified expansion pipeline Strategic account penetration and stakeholder coverage Forecast accuracy Customer relationship strength and long-term account development About Ookla, an Accenture company, is a global leader in connectivity intelligence that brings together the trusted expertise of Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics® to deliver unmatched network and connectivity insights. By combining multi-source data with industry-leading expertise, we transform network performance metrics into strategic, actionable insights. Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. From measuring and analyzing connectivity to driving industry innovation, Ookla helps the world stay connected. About Accenture Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com. Compensation Range Ookla provides a range for the base pay. Factors that may be used to determine your actual pay may include your specific job related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location. The salary compensation for this role is 400,000 - 447,000 AED. Individual pay within the compensation range for this business unit specific role is determined based on a variety of factors including experience, scope of the role, capabilities to perform the role, education and training, as well as business and company performance.

review_candidates.title: Sales Account Manager (WFH/REMOTE)
review_candidates.description: Industry: US Footwear Company - footwear component manufacturer providing advanced material solutions Salary: Negotiable with attractive benefits Working time: Monday – Friday (Remote/WFH allowed, but must ensure job performance and on-time attendance at customer's factories) MAIN PURPOSE OF JOB: Pay visits and provide service to existing customers, including shoe brand companies’ branch offices, purchasing agents and shoe factories located in Vietnam and possibly other parts of Southeast Asia. Develop new customers, particularly suitable shoe factories who may be interested in the footwear component product lines that the company has to offer. Work closely with the sales teams in the global footwear market in supplying insoles, midsoles and outsoles, and to develop custom solution tailored to meet the needs of customers. Provide extensive experience and ongoing support to footwear and shoes partners to develop world class product our diverse customers. Collaborate with R&D and production team in planning, coordination, execution and the finalization of projects according to strict deadlines. Coordinate with team members, the third-party, and shoe factories to ensure full compliances when deliver projects according to plan. SCOPE OF WORK: 1. New Sales Leads Development: Provide ongoing professional service and support to the existing shoe brand companies and shoe factories in the region. Identify new customers, particularly shoe factories in Vietnam, China and Southeast Asia. Initiate new project development plan, including timelines and potential customers to be visited, and reach out to identified customers as assigned. 2. Project Management: Work closely with production team and customer service team in VN and CN to ensure the quality test, and the delivery timeline. Respond to customers’ inquires promptly and assist sales team to check and verify details in quotations and sales contracts with respective customers. Identify potential issues and implement corrective actions as necessary. Provide weekly report to the sales team manager and discuss potential issues and possible solutions. Manage the day-to-day operations aspects of each project. JOB REQUIREMENTS: Years of experience working in Taiwanese, mainland Chinese, or other foreign invested shoe factories in Vietnam; Familiar with shoe manufacturing processes and the quality, properties, and testing standards of materials used; preferably related to work shoes, casual shoes, golf shoes, or athletic shoes. Experience in collaborating with American and European shoe brands in Vietnam, and working with shoe factories to develop designs, molds, samples, and place orders is preferred. Fluent English and Chinese communication comprehension ability. At least 5 years of working experience in Footwear and Shoes Industry. At least 3 years of working experience in Vietnam. Be able to travel the region to see brands and shoe factories. Possibly need to travel to other parts of SE Asia to assist in business development including, Cambodia, Bangladesh, Indonesia, China, etc. OTHER: Applicants could be Vietnamese citizen who meet the above criteria. Taiwanese or Chinese citizen is also welcome. Salary, benefits, insurance, and leave are negotiable. Working attitude, professional skills, interpersonal relationships, and character will be evaluated.
